messages:
carmen-devex: FYI customers hitting multiple DX bumps when combining function-calling + json_mode + schema validation in our TypeScript sample app. Wanted to consolidate notes and propose a small helpers bundle.

carmen-devex: Symptoms: app runs fine locally, fails in hosted demo with `SchemaMismatch: expected object for 'order', got string`. Logs show `value` inside `output_structured` is a JSON string.

ishan-sdk: We intentionally added a stringify guard ages ago for some browser runtimes. That guard should only run on the browser bundle, but it leaked into the Node build via a shared util.

nora-qa: Repro steps I used: checkout sample-apps/orders, set `client.responses.create({json_mode: true, function_call: {name: 'order.create', arguments_schema: orderSchema}})`, run `yarn smoke` against staging router that still returns string-encoded structured payloads.

ishan-sdk: Possible fixes: (A) SDK default: only coerce when running in browser; (B) SDK opt-in helper: `parseStructuredOutput(value, {allowStringified: false})` exported from sdk-utils; (C) Runtime: normalize responses to native JSON and add `x-rw-structured-encoding` header.

liam-runtime: Runtime plan: we'll emit header `x-rw-structured-encoding: string|json` on responses immediately and start returning native JSON by default in 2 weeks. We'll keep shim for 2 releases.

carmen-devex: Important: some teams reported the issue only after we enabled a short-circuit retry in the JS client. Suspect double-stringify if retry pipeline replays already-stringified payload. Anyone tested with retries on?

ishan-sdk: Good catch. I reproduced with retry count 1 and saw double-encoded "\"{...}\"" in the message value. Root cause: our serializer runs before retry dedupe logic. Quick patch: move serializer to transport layer so it's idempotent and add a guard to detect stringified JSON.

nora-qa: We'll add e2e permutations: (1) string-encoded from router + client with serializer; (2) native-json from router; (3) retry replay case. Added as flaky-guard tests in CI for sample-apps/orders.

ishan-sdk: I'll implement `sdkUtils.parseStructuredOutput(value, {coerce: false})` and `sdkUtils.validateStructuredOutput(schema, value, {coerceStrings: false})`. Default behavior: strict. Provide `coerce: true` for onboarding docs/examples.

liam-runtime: We'll also emit telemetry metric `structured_encoding.type` with values `string` or `json` so we can measure how many customers still hit string-encoding. Ops will surface a dashboard.

carmen-devex: For onboarding friction, please add a short migration note and snippet in the quickstart showing how to use `parseStructuredOutput` and how to enable `coerce` if integrator knowingly wants permissive behavior.

ishan-sdk: PRs: js-sdk#1062 (move serializer to transport + parse helper + tests), sample-apps#518 (update readme + CI permutations).

ops-bot: CI pipeline: js-sdk PR 1062 -> staging run queued (build 2145).

nora-qa: After patch merged, I'll run the smoke test against staging router and confirm. Also adding a short user-facing note in the SDK migration guide.

carmen-devex: Thanks team. Summary: (1) make SDK strict-by-default and export parse/validate helpers; (2) move serializer to transport layer to avoid retry double-encode; (3) runtime to add header + telemetry then normalize responses. Follow-up meeting if we see persistent customer errors next week.
